title: Block straightening input, geometric chart, and projection interfaces
statement: For a smooth finite-type characteristic-zero scheme with specified coordinate derivations, define the split-variable embeddings and flattening, mixed derivatives, old coefficient tests and monomial passing predicate, the block input, regular coefficient and pointwise coefficient maps, projection hypotheses and conclusions, the projection-free geometric chart and the original full output. Every map is the explicit original construction. The projection-free chart contains precisely the geometric fields of the full output plus surjectivity of the residue-field map at the distinguished locally closed center. No existence or proof assertion is assumed in these definitions.
